summary: Get lost in rhyming dictionaries and in pages of diphthongs when words belong to others who smother sounds in missionaries and genocide so voices can hide in peoples long forgotten. But forever heard. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Get lost in rhyming dictionaries
and in pages of diphthongs
when words belong
to others who smother
sounds in missionaries
and genocide
so voices can hide in peoples
long forgotten.
But forever heard.
#smallpoems
